# scaffold-agent

> Interactive CLI to scaffold monorepo projects for onchain AI agents (v0.1.42)

scaffold-agent generates full-stack monorepo projects with smart contracts, a frontend, and AI agent infrastructure in one command.

## Quick Start

```
npx scaffold-agent@latest
npx scaffold-agent@latest my-agent   # skips project name prompt
scaffold-agent --help                # full flag list
```

## AI Agent Setup

To give your AI agent full knowledge of scaffold-agent, have it fetch:

- **Full skill file:** https://scaffoldagent.xyz/SKILL.md — complete CLI reference, flags, generated project structure, just commands, LLM providers, network model, Intents API, MCP integration, The Graph integration, and agent on-chain tools.
- **Ethereum best practices:** https://ethskills.com/SKILL.md — Solidity patterns, contract deployment, testing, and frontend integration guidance.

## Overview

scaffold-agent is an open-source CLI that scaffolds a monorepo containing:

- Smart contracts (Foundry or Hardhat) with auto-deploy and ABI type generation
- Frontend (Next.js, Vite, or Python/Google A2A) with WalletConnect integration
- An LLM-powered agent with an Ethereum wallet for onchain interaction
- Agent on-chain tools: wallet balances, ENS resolution, ERC-8004 lookup, contract reads, 1Claw Intents, optional Graph subgraph queries
- Unified network model with `scaffold.config.ts` and `getActiveNetwork()`
- Optional multi-agent swarm mode (1–64 wallets with roster and UI)
- @1claw/mcp auto-configured (44 MCP tools for vault, Intents, signing keys, treasury)
- Optional The Graph integration (`--graph mcp|x402|both`) with `/data` page and subgraph agent tools
- HSM signing key provisioning across EVM + Bitcoin, Solana, XRP, Cardano, Tron

Supports 9 LLM upstream providers via 1Claw Shroud (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, OpenRouter, Darkbloom, Venice) plus direct OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini. Secret management via HSM vault, encrypted files, or .env.

Built on Scaffold-ETH 2 patterns, Scaffold UI (@scaffold-ui/hooks, @scaffold-ui/components, @scaffold-ui/debug-contracts), RainbowKit, wagmi, and viem.

## Post-Scaffold Workflow

```
just quickstart   # one-command: chain → fund → deploy → start
# OR step by step:
just chain        # start local blockchain (second terminal)
just fund         # fund deployer and agent wallets (100 ETH each)
just deploy       # deploy contracts and generate ABI types
just start        # launch the frontend or agent
just doctor       # health check: validate env, tools, and 1Claw IDs
```

## Key Features

- 8-step interactive wizard (project, secrets, agent, Ampersend, The Graph, LLM, chain, framework)
- Non-interactive mode (`-y`) for CI/automation with full flag control
- Config file support (`--from-config agent.json`, `--dump-config`)
- Swarm mode (`--swarm <n>`) for multi-agent setups
- The Graph subgraph integration (`--graph none|mcp|x402|both`) with MCP + x402 agent tools
- 1Claw Shroud LLM proxy with 9 upstream providers + token billing or BYOK
- 1Claw Intents API: HSM/TEE signing across 29+ EVM chains + Bitcoin, Solana, XRP, Cardano, Tron
- @1claw/mcp: 44 MCP tools auto-configured for Cursor and Claude Code
- HSM signing key provisioning (ethereum, bitcoin, solana, xrp, cardano, tron)
- Unified network switching (`just use-network base`)
- ABI type generation (Scaffold-ETH 2 pattern)
- `just quickstart` (one-command local setup) and `just doctor` (health check)
- Debug contracts page (`/debug` on Next.js)
- ERC-8004 / Agent0 identity page (`/identity`)
- Shared Header nav (Chat, Balances, ENS, Identity, Swarm, Data, Debug)
